narrative.coaching_note: Lávese las manos con agua y jabón por los 40 segundos completos antes de tocar a resident A a los 21.4 segundos. Usted tocó bed rail A con bare hand de 1.6 a 7.1 segundos y esa contaminación pasó a bare hand. Después usted tocó call button y luego phone a los 12.4 segundos, y la contaminación llegó a phone. Sin lavado, usted luego tocó a resident A a los 21.4 segundos y la contaminación llegó a resident A. Lavarse después de tocar el entorno y antes de tocar al residente es lo que piden los Momentos 5 y 1 para proteger al residente. Para este virus, el desinfectante de manos no funciona bien, use agua y jabón. Ese lavado antes del contacto habría mantenido limpios bare hand, gloved hand y resident A.
narrative.audit_summary: Staged clip with Norovirus source bed rail A. Bare hand contacted bed rail A 1.6-7.1 seconds, acquiring contamination, with onward transfers to call button at 7.6 seconds, to phone at 12.4 seconds, and to resident A at 21.4 seconds, resulting in one resident exposure. Hand hygiene compliance was 0 of 2 opportunities: Moment 5, 0 of 1 at 11 seconds after leaving the bedside environment; Moment 1, 0 of 1 at 21.4 seconds before touching resident A. No hygiene events and no glove use issues were recorded. For Norovirus, only soap and water clears hands; alcohol rub does not. Disinfect bed rail A, call button, phone, and resident A's bedside zone (linen and surfaces) with an EPA List G registered disinfectant.
narrative.top_fix: The highest-impact single change in this clip was hand hygiene with soap and water before touching resident A at 21.4 seconds.
